column1: # SoloMiner V2 - 32MB Flash OTA Partition Table
# Two 6.5MB app slots for OTA updates
# Plenty of room for firmware growth (current firmware ~3MB)
# coredump (64KB) at 0x1000000 captures a crash backtrace to flash so a field
#   panic can be extracted later (espcoredump.py / pio) instead of being lost.
#   Placed in the previously-unused upper half of the 32MB flash
#   partition offset changes (SPIFFS config + OTA layout stay intact).
